about: All events, oldest first. id, title, date, type, location and description follow the EventItem type in src/lib/site.ts; the rest is extra. The site shows the day only, never the time. Events without a date need one before they can go on the site.

events.title: ESADE Finance Club Kick-off: GreenRoom demo
events.description: The first event of the ESADE Finance Club, one of the two clubs that later merged into EMFC. Lorenzo demoed GreenRoom, a platform for finance interview prep, and the club announced a partnership giving all members free access to it.

details.speaker: Lorenzo Fabiani, founder of GreenRoom and an ESADE student

notes: Only 'around late May 2026' is known (Marketing). Vasco said to pick a day in late May, so the date is 28 May 2026.

events.title: Kick Off Dinner
events.description: The founding cohort’s first gathering as EMFC. An evening for the new team and incoming associates to meet and set the tone for the year.

events.title: Speaker session: Investment Banking at William Blair
events.description: A small-group discussion with David Karasek, ESADE alumnus and Investment Banking Analyst in William Blair’s Industrials team in London, on his move from engineering into investment banking, how recruiting works, and how to land a return offer. Key advice: apply early, show real motivation beyond the technical skills, and take initiative during internships.

details.speaker: David Karasek, ESADE alumnus and Investment Banking Analyst on William Blair’s Industrials team, London
details.format: Group discussion, in person at ESADE Sant Cugat with the speaker on video; IB team core members plus 7 selected members

notes: Title and text from Marketing's EVENTS doc (written for the website); place, time and format from Marketing's published recap. Corporate Relations called it 'Investment Banking Industry Insights with William Blair'; Investment Banking lists it in their coffee chat series.
The photo is the one Vasco took, used in Marketing's recap.

events.title: CV Screening & Optimisation
events.description: One-to-one review of members' CVs against PE and IB standards: deal sheet structure, quantified impact and formatting for buy-side applications.

events.title: Technical Training
events.description: Accounting and valuation fundamentals for PE interviews: three-statement links, EV to equity bridge and LBO mechanics.

events.title: Mock Interviews
events.description: Live PE interview simulations covering fit, technical and deal discussion questions, with individual feedback.

events.title: Exploring Careers in Finance: Alumni Roundtables (with ESADE Careers)
events.description: EMFC’s first open event, run with ESADE Careers. Five tables, one per area of finance, where students could talk directly with alumni about what working in each field is really like. Students rotated between sectors to ask alumni what the job is really like, and how they got there.

details.occasion: Career Consulting Day, run with ESADE Careers
details.tables: Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Fintech and Sustainable Investments, one alumnus each, each hosted by an EMFC member
details.private_equity_table: Moderated by Fabian Luis Seher, with Miquel Petit of Abac Capital
guests: Investment Banking: Luis Vega, Investment Banking Associate, XP Advisory
Private Equity: Miquel Petit, Private Equity Associate, Abac Capital
Venture Capital: Miguel Bowden, Portfolio Management, InnoEnergy
Fintech: Martin Nicholls, Team Lead Enterprise, Frekuent
Sustainable Finance: Cristina Costa, Sustainability Lead, Kara
details.published_as: Finance Roundtable. Five sectors. Five Esade alumni. One room full of questions. (EMFC x ESADE Careers, LinkedIn recap)

notes: Title, date, time, place and text from Marketing (EVENTS doc and published recap). The guests' names are as published in the recap: Corporate Relations' file had four of them written differently (Nichols, Acuña, Sierra, Coromina).
Private Equity sent its Abac Capital table as a separate event. It is part of this one, so list it once.

events.title: Inside Equity Research: UBS, fintech and careers in equity markets
events.description: A small-group session with Jonathan Glele Ahanhanzo, former Equity Research Analyst at UBS covering FinTech & Payments in the EMEA TMT team, now pursuing an MSc in Development Economics at the University of Oxford. How equity research is structured and what day-to-day work in TMT looks like, advice on applications, interviews and pursuing equity research roles, and current market trends in fintech and TMT. An opportunity for EMFC members to ask questions and hear first-hand perspectives on equity research and fintech.

details.speaker: Jonathan Glele Ahanhanzo, former Equity Research Analyst at UBS (FinTech & Payments, EMEA TMT team), now MSc Development Economics at the University of Oxford
key_points: Inside UBS: how equity research is structured and what day-to-day work in TMT looks like
Breaking into markets: advice on applications, interviews and pursuing equity research roles
Fintech & TMT: current market trends and the forces shaping the sector
details.format: Small group, speaker on video, members together in Room 0A04

notes: Vasco's decision: a Private Markets (Fintech) session, as Jan Heibel sent it, with Marketing's published recap as the text. Title from the recap. Room from Jan. Corporate Relations had sent it as 'Investment Banking Industry Insights with UBS'.

events.title: Coffee chat with Carson Wang
events.description: ESADE Master’s Finance Club hosted a coffee chat with Carson Wang, Wharton student with experience at Centerview Partners, Permira and Silver Lake. An informal Q&A where members asked Carson about recruiting, day-to-day life in banking and PE, and career advice, and came away with practical, honest tips from someone who has worked at top firms on both sides.

details.speaker: Carson Wang, Wharton student, previously at Centerview Partners (banking) and Permira and Silver Lake (private equity) in New York
details.format: Coffee chat, Q&A session. Members together in a meeting room at ESADE, the speaker on video; Marketing's recap calls it a virtual session

notes: Text, speaker, organiser and format from Marketing (EVENTS doc and published recap). Marketing had no date; the date and time are Private Equity's (29 October 2026, 17:30). Private Equity sent the event as theirs and described Carson as 'Incoming PE Analyst at Silver Lake, formerly IB Summer Analyst at Centerview Partners'.

events.title: Networking Event with I Squared Capital
events.description: An exclusive session for EMFC members on working at I Squared Capital and its recruiting process, followed by a networking cocktail with recruiters and professionals from the firm.
notes: Corporate Relations wrote the text before the event, in the future tense; it is reworded here in the past tense with the same content (their original is in 'sources'). Marketing's recap will replace it once published. Vasco has an internal document from Fabian Seher about the event, which is not for the website.
